seeds.title: Firm benchmark: demand growth needed to fill a new hospital
seeds.text: Across nine hospital openings in mid-sized cities, a new 150-bed hospital needed private inpatient demand to grow at least 8% a year to fill within three years. Method: review of firm hospital projects, 2019 to 2025. Sample data (simulated).

seeds.title: CareData Nakuru Hospital Outlook 2026
seeds.text: We forecast that private inpatient days in Nakuru County will grow 9.5% a year from 2025 to 2030. Method: admissions model built on insurer claims data. Sample data (simulated).

seeds.title: Firm county study: private inpatient demand in Nakuru
seeds.text: Our 2025 county study found private inpatient demand in Nakuru growing 9 to 11% a year. Method: interviews with 14 hospitals and their admissions records. Sample data (simulated).

seeds.title: Private hospital demand in Nakuru to grow 9.5% a year
seeds.text: Private hospital demand in Nakuru will grow 9.5% a year, according to the CareData Nakuru Hospital Outlook 2026. Sample data (simulated).

seeds.title: Why Nakuru needs more hospitals
seeds.text: Demand for private beds in Nakuru is exploding at 20% a year, and every new hospital will be full. Sample data (simulated).

seeds.title: Forum thread: hospitals in Nakuru
seeds.text: Someone said demand is up 50% a year. Sample data (simulated).

seeds.title: Household survey: health insurance cover by county
seeds.text: Health insurance covered 21% of residents of Nakuru County in 2025. Method: national household survey of 24,000 homes. Sample data (simulated).

seeds.title: Insurance membership by county, 2025
seeds.text: Our panel shows 22% of Nakuru County residents held health insurance in 2025. Method: insurer membership records matched to census counts. Sample data (simulated).

seeds.title: Firm review: staffing new hospitals
seeds.text: Hiring a registered nurse for a new hospital in a mid-sized city took 5 months on average in 2025. Method: review of six hospital openings and their hiring records. Sample data (simulated).

seeds.title: Expert call: former hospital operations director
seeds.text: Hiring nurses for a new hospital outside the capital usually takes 4 to 7 months. Specialist nurses take longer. Sample data (simulated).
